main_text.p: rum Hebraeo-Samaritanorum seorsim edi curavit.{n} In quo tamen opere ea quæ de hoc Argumento ab illo desiderabantur, non omnino explicuisse visus fuit, iis præsertim, qui callent haisce literas.

PERESCIUS præter memoratos jam supra Samaritanorum codices miserat etiam ad Morinum duas eorundemSamaritanorum ad Josephum Scaligerum Epistolas, quarum prima Synagogæ urbis Sichem nomine scripta; altera vero nomine Samaritanorum in Ægypto commorantium, quæ tamen Epistolæ ad manus Scaligeri nunquam pervenerant, sed Genebrardo redditæ, & ut audio, nunc in Bibliotheca Regis Christianissimi asservantur: utramque Morinus ex autographo in Latinum sermonem[?] convertit, cujus tamen Interpretatio nondum in lucem edita fuit. In his Samaritani Sca-ligero aperiunt gentis suæ mores ac ritus, & qua in re ipsi a Judæis, quos violatæ legis Mosaicæ reos peragunt, diserepens.

page.notes: The word "termonem" in "Latinum termonem" is partly covered by an ink spot; the reading "sermonem" is a likely reconstruction and is marked [?]. "eorundemSamaritanorum" is printed without a space at the line end and is kept as printed. The fragments of letters along the left edge belong to the neighbouring page or are show-through and are left out. Ink spots appear in the text and in the upper left corner; they are not text.
